methods.description: Two ordered complete source/geometry analyses of the exact retained two-family scope. Inputs are the pinned Atlas baseline, whole consumed source products, full containing component shards and captured direct DGT/IGN features.
methods.software: Bundled CPython 3.12; NumPy 2.3.3; PyProj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2 / GEOS; WorldAtlas evidence helper; producer commit 3df6fa1e47f05238087b838a69b0134513ed0f37.
methods.units: m² (WGS84 ellipsoidal area), m (WGS84 geodesic line length), unitless coverage fractions

conclusions.text: Four complete direct municipal-item response bodies and two complete Spanish administrative-boundary line-item bodies are captured with original response envelopes, retrieval times, CRS headers and whole-body byte receipts.

The official item responses declare CRS84 longitude-latitude; the DGT collection also reports EPSG:3763 storage CRS. Direct comparison used returned CRS84 coordinates without an additional transformation.

All four full gap components are overwhelmingly covered by the union of the four current official municipal items, with the measured per-component residuals preserved; this does not establish physical class or ownership.

The four old-to-official candidate polygon pairs have nonzero symmetric differences; official item effective dates are absent or unresolved, so historical or operational equivalence is not established.
The two Spanish boundary-line records report agreed/date attributes but the available captures do not establish matching Portuguese-side line geometry or bilateral legal authority.
The direct DGT 2025 product collection metadata reports a 2000–2007 temporal extent, which conflicts with the product page and 2026 approval notice; item-level effective dates are unresolved.
